SECTCORD.description: Section Coordinates (SECTCORD). Returns the outer/inner polygon vertex coordinates of a section; driven by the target section number and a position along the member.

Argument.description: Request selecting which section to compute coordinates for.

SECT.description: Section number (Sect No). The section whose polygon coordinates are computed; must reference an existing section in the opened project.

POS.description: Position (dPos) along the member/section at which the section polygon is evaluated.
